title: RDF4J distinguishes an empty group relation from one unbound row
summary: The parent returned one unbound row for an explicitly grouped empty graph. The fix returned zero. An implicit aggregate still returned one unbound row. Adding the first matching triple made the subquery join produce both markers once.

change.description: The query evaluator now distinguishes an empty input grouped by a named variable from an aggregate over the whole empty input.

notes: All RDF4J modules on each classpath came from that side’s setup build. Its independently recorded module hashes are in setup/artifacts.sha256.
Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
